fieldValues.title: Protocol resources over MCP
fieldValues.summary: A Protocol was reachable over MCP only via a Blueprint prompt whose first rootTypes entry happened to match its targetType. This unit adds a direct read surface — a list resource and a definition-with-stages resource — as an adapter over the existing protocol service.
fieldValues.body: PR https://github.com/the-greenman/srs-rust/pull/965. srs://<repositoryId>/protocol lists every installed Protocol as the service's ProtocolSummary verbatim; srs://<repositoryId>/protocol/{protocolId} serves { protocol, stages } — the stored definition as srs protocol get returns it, plus stages sorted by order as srs protocol stages returns them, so dependsOn resolves forward. Unknown id returns MCP resource-not-found. Concrete resources are enumerated per Protocol, a template advertises the definition URI, and the connect-time instructions mention both. The direct consumer is this programme's own programme-unit-walk Protocol. Gates exit 0: cargo build, test, clippy -D warnings, fmt --check, with a new MCP integration test against a fixture carrying a deliberately out-of-order 2-stage Protocol.
